properties.plot_summary: A mosaic of interrelated people in the San Fernando Valley navigate grief, regret and the messy aftermath of past choices as their lives brush against one another. The film follows a dying television tycoon and those around him — his estranged son, his wife, his nurse — alongside a gameshow host, a troubled daughter, a police officer, a child prodigy and other figures whose emotional needs intersect in unexpected ways. Through overlapping vignettes the characters confront abandonment, addiction, ego and the possibility of forgiveness, while chance and coincidence push several storylines toward a startling climax. The result is an intimate, often surreal portrait of longing and the search for meaning amid everyday desperation.

properties.description: Marvelous and the Black Hole (2021), directed by Kate Tsang and starring Miya Cech, Rhea Perlman, and Leonardo Nam, is a comedy-drama about a grieving teenage girl who forms an unlikely bond with a surly children’s party magician. properties.plot_summary: A troubled teenage delinquent named Sammy is grappling with the recent death of her mother and the strain of a father who is trying to move on. Over the course of their relationship, the two women help each other confront loneliness, responsibility, and the possibility of healing.

properties.description: The Immaculate Conception of Little Dizzle (2010), written and directed by David Russo and starring Marshall Allman, Jeanette Maus, and Sean Nelson, is an indie comedy-drama that follows a dislocated young man who takes a night janitor job at a market-research firm. He and his ragtag crew uncover clandestine experiments that lead to bizarre side effects, propelling the film into surreal and blackly comedic territory. Combining satirical commentary on corporate life with religious undertones and striking visual effects, the movie examines faith, identity, and exploitation through an offbeat, character-driven lens.
properties.plot_summary: After losing his steady job, a disoriented young man takes a night janitor position at a market-research firm and joins a ragged crew of nocturnal cleaners. While working late he uncovers clandestine experiments on employees that produce bizarre, escalating side effects. As the group's lives unravel, surreal imagery and black comedy mix with questions of faith, identity, and exploitation. The film follows his strange initiation into a world where corporate routine mutates into disturbing, unpredictable madness.
